description: This Java source file defines the FindPhoneActivity class, which is an Android Activity responsible for creating and updating a wearable notification with actions to toggle or cancel an alarm related to finding the phone. It manages notification construction, intent creation for alarm control, and notification display updates.

classes.name: FindPhoneActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages a wearable notification allowing the user to toggle or cancel an alarm for finding the phone.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates a notification with action buttons to toggle and cancel an alarm, and displays it.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: A static method that updates the notification text to reflect the current alarm state.
